product.name: Kimberley Nulla Nulla 4WD Camping Safari Tour
product.shortDescription: Twenty one day camping Safari travelling to the major destination of The Kimberley and some hidden gems that will amaze you and immerse you in one of the worlds last frontiers. Meals are amazing! Bungle Bungles are incredible.
product.description:
TOUR REGION
The Kimberley Region, Western Australia.

TOUR TYPE
Camping Safari-Tent Accommodation

ALTERNATIVE TOUR
A fully accommodated tour is located here: https://www.skyroadtrail.com.au/events/kimberley-nulla-nulla-14-day-scenic-tour-fully-accommodated

DURATION
21 Days, 20 Nights

TOUR STAGES
Stage 1: BROOME TO KUNUNURRA – Great Northern Highway
Stage 2:KUNUNARRA TO LAKE ARGYLE
Stage 3: KUNUNARRA TO WYNDHAM
Stage 4: KUNUNURRA TO BROOME – Gibb River Road
Stage 5: CAPE LEVEQUE

TOUR HIGHLIGHTS AND AUTHENTIC EXPERIENCES
– Helicopter flights over the Bungle Bungles and Mitchell Falls
– Travel in authentic 4WD’s sedans and troupe carriers (Not Buses)
– Pender Bay – an amazing experience that very few tours go to. It is a must experience!
– Wolfe Creek Meteorite Crater – an amazing experience that very few tours go to. It is a must experience!
– Our meals are amazing!
– We are one of the longest tours 21 days – that means you see more (Everyday is amazing)
– Two boat cruises which Large Argyle

INTRODUCING
Welcome to the last wilderness frontier of Australia, the famous Kimberley! Embark on a once-in-a-lifetime journey through the incredible arid Savannah, immersing yourself in the awe-inspiring beauty of the world heritage-listed Bungle Bungles during our yearly Kimberley Nulla Nulla Bash.

The Nulla Nulla is a tour like no other, limited to a maximum of eight vehicles in the convoy held annually.

Prepare to be enchanted as you swim in numerous breathtaking gorges and waterfalls, bask in the glorious Western Australian sun during amazing short hikes (ranging from 2 to 4 kilometers), and camp under the majestic Baob trees at our specially selected campsites.

Wildlife enthusiasts will be delighted by the abundance of viewing opportunities, including crocodiles, emus, kangaroos, jabirus, brolgas, camels, dingoes, barramundi (which may even find their way onto our dinner plates if we’re lucky enough to catch a legal one), snakes, and perhaps even spiders—thanks to Sharon, our guide’s uncanny knack for finding them.

Our adventure continues along the famous Gibb River Road—a 660-kilometer stretch of mostly corrugated road that offers one of Australia’s most unique 4WD experiences. We’ll traverse rivers, conquer small 4WD sections, and revel in the breathtaking scenery that surrounds us. Along the way, we’ll have the rare opportunity to spend a night on the banks of the Pentecost River and explore tracks that are rarely driven.

Prepare to be captivated by Lake Argyle—a hidden gem teeming with an estimated 35,000 freshwater crocodiles. We’ll spend a day exploring its vast reaches, embark on a scenic cruise, and for those feeling adventurous, take a dip alongside these fascinating creatures. In the afternoon, we’ll cool off in the award-winning infinity pool that overlooks the lake—an experience worthy of an Instagram post.

Our journey wouldn’t be complete without a visit to El Questro Station—a beautiful oasis boasting incredible facilities and fantastic gorges. Immerse yourself in nature’s wonders as you soak in thermal springs and embark on captivating walks. fantastic gorges, thermal springs & walks. We recommend a lunch stop here for their delicious Pizza.

Through Fitzroy Crossing and Halls Creek

Bungle Bungles

Stage 2: KUNUNARRA TO LAKE ARGYLE
Spend the day at Lake Argyle, Western Australia’s largest and Australia’s second-largest freshwater man-made reservoir by volume. Included cruise on the lake.

Stage 3: KUNUNARRA TO WYNDHAM|

Stage 5: CAPE LEVEQUE

Camel ride at Cable Beach
Gantheaume Point Dinosaur Prints
Cable Beach Sunset and Champagne Toast
Staircase to the moon


Please note that while we strive to visit every destination listed in our itinerary, unforeseen circumstances such as weather conditions, mechanical issues, or access restrictions may arise. Our priority is to ensure your safety and well-being throughout the trip. Therefore, the itinerary is subject to change if necessary.

For additional activities such as visiting Horizontal Falls or participating in El Questro Activities, please check with us first regarding availability and booking dates.

EQUIPMENT
What Equipment will we be taking: Food supplies for three weeks, portable fridges/freezers, spare tyres, additional fuel supplies, additional 4WD auto parts, satellite messaging service, satellite phone service, personal Location Beacon, 4 first aid kits, 4WD recovery kits & tracks, tyre repair kits/plugs, winch, air compressors, two-way radios in all cars, plus a whole lot more to add this list.

MEALS
All breakfasts and dinners are included. We also cater for gluten-free, vegetarian and other dietary needs. Meals range from traditional camping-type meals through to gourmet-inspired meals. Our breakfasts and dinners are plentiful.

ACCOMMODATION
The trip is wilderness camping in areas that do not have facilities most nights. We do supply a portable toilet with toilet en-suite tent that works very well and is comfortable as far as camping equipment is concerned. We also carry a shower (hot water) to ensure you can freshen up during your adventure.

INCLUSIONS AND EXCLUSIONS

INCLUDED
Helicopter over Bungle Bungles: This experience is highly recommended and included in the package.
Helicopter over Mitchell Falls: Another highly recommended activity that is included in the trip.
All breakfasts
All Dinners
ALL ACCOMMODATION (except for the last day when the trip ends at 6pm)

NOT INCLUDED
Please note that airfares and insurance are not included in the package. Lunches are not supplied, but we will take you to places where you can buy lunch, and we will also visit shops to stock up on lunches when we are in remote areas. We like to support local businesses in this manner.

ACTIVITY ADD ONS
If you’re interested, there is an optional add-on activity called Horizontal Falls. The approximate cost for this experience is $850.00, as charged by the operator ex Broome. It includes a fly (small plane) ride, boat tour, speed boat ride to the falls, return boat ride, and return flight experience.

This trip is advertised on multiple platforms, and you can find the detailed Terms and Conditions listed on our website. By making a deposit for the trip you agree with the terms and conditions of the trip.

We look forward to us joining us on this epic adventure! It promises to be a thrilling experience that you’ll remember for years to come.

Trip Tour Leaders – Patrick & Sharon

Trip Operator - Sky Road Trail
